pages.raw_title: Golden Entertainment - Nevada Casinos, Hotels & Taverns
pages.raw_meta: Golden Entertainment runs 7 Nevada casino resorts, including The STRAT, plus 74 neighborhood taverns. Earn True Rewards points at every location. Explore now.
raw_blocks: IN A BUSINESS THAT’S MOSTLY FLASH,
REAL ENTERTAINMENT FOR REAL PEOPLE

Through our group of casinos, taverns, and gaming, we create world-class experiences at a world-class value. Visit any of our locations and you'll find real food, real drink pours and really good times.
Seven casinos in Nevada, including The STRAT.
74 NEIGHBORHOOD PUBS & TAVERNS
The locals' preferred choice for gaming, food and all-around entertainment.
Rewards that actually pay off
True Rewards members rack up points when they play at any of our casinos or taverns and can redeem points at any location, all on one card!
Our success comes from the dedication and commitment of team members working towards one goal: to create a positive guest experience. See what else we're all about.
IT ALL STARTED IN 2001
We’re proud of our history, growing from a small gaming company to a premier, diverse gaming corporation. Our operation spans two divisions: casinos and taverns.
Southwest Services purchased and renamed to Golden Gaming
23 PT's locations purchased from the Boeckle brothers
First Sierra Gold opened in Reno, NV
New corporate offices built to employ 250 team members
Pahrump Nugget Hotel & Casino acquired
Gold Town Casino and Lakeside Casino & RV Park acquired
Four Sean Patrick's Pubs are acquired and remodeled
Rocky Gap Casino Resort acquired from Lakes Entertainment
Stratosphere Hotel & Casino acquired from American Casino & Entertainment Properties
Aquarius Casino Resort acquired from American Casino & Entertainment Properties
Arizona Charlie's Decatur and Boulder acquired from American Casino & Entertainment Properties
Edgewater Hotel Casino Resort and Colorado Belle Hotel Casino Resort acquired from Marnell Gaming
Rocky Gap Casino Resort sold to Century Casinos & VICI Properties
Four Lucky's branded taverns acquired
Golden's third-party distributed gaming operations in Montana sold to J&J Ventures
Golden's third party distributed gaming operations in Nevada sold to J&J Ventures
Two Great American Pub branded tavern acquired
